# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want the tasks that belong to no story audited, so that the audit covers the whole board

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** the 10 tasks that belong to no story audited
**So that** the audit covers the whole board, not only what hangs off an epic

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given each of these 10 tasks, when it is read, then it matches the
      task template, meets the writing standard, and its claims hold against
      the code as it is now (`audit-check.py 316 --tree` for the mechanical half)
- [ ] Given each criterion, when it is read, then it names a test, a CI step
      or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date
      (`audit-check.py 316 --tree`)
- [ ] Given each task, when its `## No parent` section is read, then it
      states a real reason, not a placeholder
- [ ] Given each task, when its metadata is read, then it carries one type
      label, one priority label and an assignee (`audit-check.py 316 --tree`)
- [ ] Given a task that turns out to belong under an existing story, when
      that is found, then it is re-parented and the finding recorded
      (`audit-check.py 316 --tree` reports no missing parent link)

## Definition of Ready
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 3

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
These sit outside the epic hierarchy, so no per-epic story under #251
reaches them. Bugs are covered separately by #312.

7 of them are the audit's own tooling, written during this epic. They are
audited to the same standard as everything else, not exempted for being
recent.
